messages.subject: Milkweed
messages.text: I have a packet in my cart. Happy to support but you charge more then 1/2 the product cost for shipping this little packet of seeds, and then the discount won’t apply.. pretty disappointed!

messages.subject: Re: Milkweed
messages.text:
Hi MB,

Thank you for your patience on this, and sorry for the long wait to hear back from us. We had a very intense stretch and some staffing challenges, and your message deserved a reply well before now.

To your point: the shipping cost on a single seed packet does look steep next to the price of the packet itself, and that's fair. The honest answer is that a single packet doesn't really cover its own shipping for us either, but we accept that trade-off because we want milkweed in as many gardens as possible. Ordering a few packets at once brings the per-packet shipping down a fair bit.

On the discount code: if it didn't apply at checkout, the usual reason is simply that the code wasn't entered in the promo field, or that seed packets aren't part of that particular promotion. If you let me know which code you were trying, I'll check whether it applies and, if it does, apply it to your order directly.

One thing worth knowing: seed packets ship by regular stamped mail, which keeps the cost lower than tracked parcels, and they usually arrive within 5 to 12 business days.

Warmly,
__
 Gabriel Gouveia 
Co-founder
Lasclay.com
